title: ID0442151-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001157]  Limit charger to 120kW
description:

additional_info.subject: ID0442151-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001157]  Issue with the charging station. CRM:02682000275
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph, good morning.
Can you please confirm if the 120kW is the maximum limit or per outlet? The reason why I ask this question is because the charger was built to provide a total of 160kW.
I changed the configuration for a maximum of 120kW per outlet but the total would be around 130kVA, is this ok for the grid or are the 120kVa and not kW?
I will wait for your feedback.
best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0442151-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001157]  Issue with the charging station. CRM:02682000275
additional_info.body:

Thank you for increasing the regulation to 120 kW. It can stay that way.
Best regards,
Ralph
